web-guide-idea-12.audience: History enthusiasts and people with a connection to an old neighbourhood.
web-guide-idea-12.offer: Offer a story-led walk through a compact old-city route. Distinguish documented history from local anecdotes instead of presenting every legend as fact.
web-guide-idea-12.steps.0: Research two or three buildings and confirm access.
web-guide-idea-12.steps.1: Walk the route with clear pauses for stories and architectural details.
web-guide-idea-12.steps.2: Finish with questions and suggestions for another lane.
web-guide-idea-12.equipment: A phone and power bank; earphones with a microphone help keep narration clear in traffic.
web-guide-idea-12.returnReason: Build a neighbourhood series with a different era, craft or meeting place each time.
web-guide-idea-12.promotion: Post a close-up of a doorway and the question your walk will answer. Avoid unsupported historical claims.
web-guide-idea-12.metadataTitle: Purani Galiyon Ki Kahani — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-12.metadataDescription: Walk through an old city and tell the stories behind its lanes, buildings and familiar meeting places. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
